summary: GitSyncDeploy README gained a bullet on gitblit-app's JVM options: explicit GCs are disabled because Gitblit's Lucene cycle calls System.gc() after each indexed repository, and JAVA_OPTS spells out the heap maximum (committed e0061ba on GitSyncDeploy main, fast-forwarded first to origin's 29395a0; lint and test gates green). AnsibleSpecs doctrine, the argo-cd set and the Ansible runbooks needed no edit, and there is no commit on phase/043-docs. Every claim was checked against upstream Gitblit 1.10.0 LuceneService and defaults.properties and against gitblit-docker's docker-entrypoint.sh; no claim is left unverified.
